limitations: This manifest covers the complete magnetics group for one deliberately forced VDE shot, not a balanced disruption/non-disruption cohort.
Channel-to-geometry mapping, calibration, quality, uncertainty, event identity, observation operators, and cross-clock relationships remain unresolved.

The upstream FAIR-MAST group reports ingestion identity https://github.com/ukaea/fair-mast-ingestion/tree/ab435c799d892956fb042d55391f7d1be0c950e6 (dirty); dirty state is preserved and prevents clean-release interpretation.
Raw Zarr objects remain on owner-controlled scratch/storage and the official FAIR-MAST endpoint; this repository tracks hashes, provenance, schema, and canonical evidence.
